“Is this the Perfection of the Xuanhuang Physique at the Tenth Rank?”

At the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan tentatively tried his physical strength, his face showing delight.

Only within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would he dare to do this; in the outside world, the terrifying power of his physical body could potentially impact entire Star Domains.

Merely with pure physical strength,

Could he suppress a Tier 11 life of the second category?

...

What did that mean?

In terms of pure physical strength, it was estimated that even the Peak Powerhouses of Eleventh Rank could not do better.

Now the only ones that could surpass Lin Yuan in physical strength were the Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives.

“Now my Understanding of Rules is actually not as good as my physical body,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. In fact, his Understanding of Rules was by no means low,

By the Tenth Rank, he had reached the Dual Realm of Time-Space Fusion Rules, something no one could claim to be inferior throughout the Cosmic Eras.

But compared to his physical body, it was still slightly lacking,

Especially after completing the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and remodeling his physical body based on the structure of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

Plus the other enhancements to his physical attributes.

As a result—

The strength of Lin Yuan’s physical body far exceeded expectations.

The Perfection of the Xuanhuang Physique at the Tenth Rank alone cost hundreds of billions of Cubic Universe Crystals; when reaching Tier 11, to cultivate to Tier 11 Perfection, that price…

Lin Yuan was not without preparation for the cultivation resources needed for the Perfection of the Xuanhuang Physique at Tier 11. The nearly hundred rare objects he obtained from the Two-dimensional World, even if not completely filling the gap, would not fall short by much.

But let it be known that Lin Yuan also possessed the Taiyang Divine Spirit and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

“We’ll see when the time comes.”

Lin Yuan did not ponder any further; the enhancement the Xuanhuang Physique provided to himself was too significant, after reaching Tier 11, he could always go to a Large Alien Battlefield to slaughter and gather resources.

Once Lin Yuan stepped into Tier 11 with his current strength, he would be invincible within that Tier, where even the Four Divine Kings and the Mother of the Tree Realm, such legendary beings, would have to step aside.

If Lin Yuan wanted, it was entirely possible for him to slaughter through a Large Alien Battlefield and thereby obtain a massive amount of Cultivation Resources.

As for why not go to a Large Alien Battlefield now? With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he still could not ignore those Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives wielding supreme weapons.

But upon reaching Tier 11, after undergoing another Chaos Void Origin Infusion, he should be about there.

“Apart from the Xuanhuang Physique, I’ve nearly perfected the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ and the ‘Nine Steps of Space-Time.’

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, a trace of Xuanhuang energy vibrating, making every strike he delivered reach five times the limit of his strength.

The cost was a much greater expenditure of energy.

But such consumption was nothing more than a drop in the ocean compared to the vast Inner World of Lin Yuan.

“When the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reaches the Five-Layered Realm or Sixth Realm, I’ll be ready to step into Tier 11.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that with his current accumulation, he could strike at Tier 11 at any time, ensuring a one hundred percent success rate.

However, doing it that way would mean that the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule level would not be sufficient, and his Inner World would not be able to bear the highest level of Chaos Void Origin, which might not be cost-effective.

For almost all life forms, they would never have the opportunity to undergo a Chaos Void Origin Infusion in their lifetime.

For a few life forms with astonishing talent, they get one chance, which is when they cultivate to the Eleventh Rank Peak and then strike for the Ultimate Realm.

Lin Yuan, who had comprehended the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank, only had three opportunities for Chaos Void Origin Infusions, so he naturally cherished them and aimed to maximize his gains.

“The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule…” Lin Yuan allocated a fraction of his consciousness to continue comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

The stronger the life force, the more tumultuous the waves would be in the River of Time, which would lead to a deeper comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

Adding to that, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Comprehension from the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, Lin Yuan was improving his own Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Comprehension almost every second.

Whoosh!

Lin Yuan took a step and arrived above the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Spatiotemporal Fusion?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the deeper his comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules became, the more he felt the incredible nature of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The method that seamlessly integrated into countless Spatial Layers of the universe was beyond imagination.

At least Lin Yuan was far from capable of achieving it now,

Within the Space-Time Perception of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, those in the Five-Layered Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rules were far from achieving it,

Even beings reaching the Sixth Realm, Seventh Realm, or Eighth Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rules amongst the Supreme Beings probably couldn’t achieve it either.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan stood above the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and a Six-Armed Silhouette appeared nearby, respectfully saying, “Congratulations, Master, on perfecting the Xuanhuang Physique.”

For Lin Yuan, cultivating the Xuanhuang Physique only required sufficient resources.

But that was based on Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding. In fact, cultivating the Xuanhuang Physique still required high comprehension; it was just that compared to the other two Dao-Protecting Secret Skills, it was not as heavily weighted.

“It’s just the Perfection at Tenth Rank.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly as he spoke. His strength had long surpassed the Tenth Rank.

“Just the Tenth Rank?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette laughed somewhat forcefully, if not for his memory of the numerous Disciple legends in the Profound Yellow Lineage, who exhausted infinite Heart Force and resources in cultivating the Xuanhuang Physique, he might have believed it.

And Lin Yuan’s Perfection of the Xuanhuang Physique at the Tenth Rank was almost comparable to the Eleventh Rank Complete Xuanhuang Physique.

“What level has His Majesty Xuan Huang reached in his comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules?”

After carefully observing the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for a while, Lin Yuan couldn’t help but ask.
